the role of AI in the digital financial inclusion of the poor, women and youths.
the impact of AI and its various tools and applications on digital financial inclusion and the benefits of AI in addressing the problem of financial exclusion.
the use of AI to improve digital financial inclusion.

Artificial Intelligence (AI), and its applications, have an impact on digital financial inclusion, and the impact is positive.
the use of AI in financial institutions and nonfinancial institutions has a positive influence on the financial inclusion of the vulnerable groups of the society.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AI has a positive impact on digital financial inclusion.
the use of AI is critical in ensuring that the vulnerable groups are included in the formal financial sector.
AI has a positive impact on digital financial inclusion and therefore it would be beneficial to scale up the use and adoption of AI in financial services and financial inclusion initiatives.
The main takeaway from our work is that

AI can be used to address some of the problems that have hitherto made it difficult for people to be active in the formal financial markets and that it is important for financial institutions to invest in AI tools and applications to ensure that their customers are able to access their services and products.
AI is not only a tool for improving efficiency and effectiveness in the financial sector but also for achieving the goal of digital inclusion.
the application of AI in financial institutions is not only a means to an end but it has the potential to transform the financial services industry.
